# NSWPEDIA

> A Nintendo Switch reference site: a structured game database (Title IDs, Build IDs,
> firmware requirements, file types and sizes, language support, version history), hands-on
> emulator compatibility testing on named hardware, setup guides, and a homebrew library
> limited to software licensed for redistribution.

NSWPEDIA does not host, mirror or link to commercial game files, system firmware or
encryption keys. Compatibility results are first-party tests, each stamped with the device
and date it was run.

## Core sections

- [Game database](https://nsw-pedia.com/games/): per-game technical metadata and tested emulator compatibility.
- [Emulators](https://nsw-pedia.com/emulators/): platform support, requirements, licence and maintenance status for each emulator.
- [Guides](https://nsw-pedia.com/guides/): file format references, setup walkthroughs and hardware recommendations.
- [Homebrew](https://nsw-pedia.com/homebrew/): open-source and public-domain Switch software.

## Editorial

- [How we test](https://nsw-pedia.com/methodology/): hardware, procedure and status rating definitions.
- [About](https://nsw-pedia.com/about/): what the site publishes and what it does not.
- [Legal & DMCA](https://nsw-pedia.com/legal/): copyright position and takedown procedure.

## Citation

Compatibility figures should be cited with the emulator, device and test date shown in the
row, since results change as emulator builds change.
